subject.title: feat: add hosted feed envelope verifier

question: Should this isolated DSSE/Ed25519 hosted feed verifier land now as the foundation for the signed marketplace feed trust stack?
rationale: The code review found no concrete patch defect, but the exported verifier semantics become the trust boundary consumed by later feed config and refresh PRs, so automation should not decide the security model alone.

options.title: Land the verifier foundation
options.body: Accept this isolated primitive after exact-head gates pass, keeping feed config, refresh enforcement, trust-state persistence, and CLI visibility in the existing follow-up PRs.

options.title: Hold for full stack review
options.body: Pause this PR until maintainers review the verifier together with the config, refresh, CLI, and default-root slices as one security design.

options.title: Request a narrower verifier API
options.body: Ask for API, error-shape, or trust-contract changes now if maintainers want a different permanent boundary before follow-up PRs consume it.

recommendation.title: Land the verifier foundation
recommendation.body: Accept this isolated primitive after exact-head gates pass, keeping feed config, refresh enforcement, trust-state persistence, and CLI visibility in the existing follow-up PRs.
